fields.name: datasets_used
fields.description: Biomedical datasets, corpora, benchmarks, or data sources used to train, fine-tune, validate, or evaluate the LLM or related system.
fields.example: PubMed abstracts, MIMIC-III clinical notes, MedQA, BioASQ

fields.name: methods
fields.description: The LLM approach, model architecture, prompting strategy, fine-tuning method, retrieval setup, or experimental design used in the study.
fields.example: Zero-shot prompting with GPT-4; retrieval-augmented generation using PubMed articles

fields.name: key_findings
fields.description: Main results, conclusions, or notable observations reported by the paper about LLM performance or utility in biomedicine.
fields.example: The model improved clinical question answering accuracy and produced more fluent summaries, but hallucinations remained common

fields.name: evaluation_metrics
fields.description: Metrics or criteria used to assess performance, quality, safety, or usefulness of the LLM system.
fields.example: Accuracy, F1 score, ROUGE, BLEU, exact match, human expert rating

fields.name: biomedical_task
fields.description: The specific biomedical or clinical task addressed by the LLM study.
fields.example: Clinical question answering, medical text summarization, diagnosis support, information extraction

fields.name: llm_model_or_family
fields.description: The large language model(s) or model family evaluated or discussed in the paper.

fields.name: biomedical_domain_context
fields.description: The biomedical subdomain or health AI setting in which the LLM is applied.
fields.example: Radiology, oncology, electronic health records, biomedical literature mining

fields.name: study_type
fields.description: The publication or study design relevant to evidence synthesis.
fields.example: Benchmark evaluation, clinical validation, user study, review, methodological paper

fields.name: comparison_baselines
fields.description: Any baseline models, alternative methods, or human comparators used for comparison.
fields.example: Compared against BERT, traditional machine learning models, and physician annotations

fields.name: limitations_or_risks
fields.description: Reported limitations, failure modes, safety concerns, or risks associated with the LLM approach in biomedicine.
fields.example: Hallucinations, limited generalizability, privacy concerns, bias in clinical recommendations
